adjudication.rationale: The diff does show that `evt.destinationCalendar` can contain multiple calendars for collective team events (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`), but when persisting the Booking it only connects `evt.destinationCalendar[0]` (Prisma connect at the end of `handleNewBooking.ts`). So any additional destination calendars used during event creation are not stored on the Booking record. However, from the diff alone it’s not verifiable that this causes broken behavior/data loss beyond this intentional schema limitation (Booking appears to only have a single `destinationCalendar` relation), since multi-calendar follow-up operations are increasingly driven by per-calendar `references` rather than `booking.destinationCalendar`.
